name: Electrochemical Technology
description: Ionic solution, ionic equilibrium; ion-ion interactions: Debye-Huckel theory, electric double layer; ionic transport: migration, extended Nernst-Planck equation. Redox reactions at electrode, electrochemical cell, electrochemical equilibrium, electrode potential, Nernst equation, reversible electrodes; electrode kinetics: Butler-Volmer formulation, linearized form, Tafel equation, design of electrolyzers, batteries - insertion electrodes, maximum theoretical specific energy (MTSE), lead acid, nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) batteries, Li-ion cells, battery characterizations – state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), C-rate, current-voltage (IV) curve, equivalent circuit model of a cell, overview of supercapacitor and fuel cell, metal finishing, corrosion.
